subject: Obstruction - Southwestern Shore
text:
Obstruction - Southwestern Shore
A Sofar Spotter buoy has been deployed at 44°27'00.3"N 64°22'36.2"W. It is bright yellow and black in colour and measures roughly 40 cm in diameter and 30 cm in height. To it is attached a smaller cylindrical buoy with additional reflectors.
 The buoy will remain in place until at most early December. Caution.
